decisions.reason: The existing message-210 MODIFY already requires the fiat-buyer FAQ to describe step-by-step guidance for viewing or converting prize funds, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Winner guidance email contents do not change the authentication method or dashboard-access behavior; the separate email-link access instructions are already represented.
The new guidance belongs to winner email content and does not require the About page to present that step-by-step guidance.
The winner-guidance email change does not alter the landing page's content or layout requirements.
Guidance emailed to prize winners has no effect on whether or where the book cover appears on the landing page.
The added email guidance does not change SIWE, supported user paths, or protected wallet-authentication flows.
Winner guidance email contents do not affect authentication requirements or exposed information for public APIs.
Post-win guidance for viewing or converting funds does not change the deferred Transak mint provider, payment methods, wallet provisioning, or mint destination.
The prize-fund guidance email is unrelated to the PDF.js reader engine and ebook reader entry points.
The prize payout remains an automatic wallet transfer; adding explanatory email guidance does not change the payout or claim mechanism.
Winner guidance email contents do not change the referral-code source, persistence, or display locations.
Guidance for viewing or converting prize funds does not affect secondary royalty amount, enforcement, disclosure, pool funding, or ticket behavior.
